status: measured and recorded. Completes the free-fermion-plus-measurement arc R1J opened and R1K half-answered. Two successive misreadings of the same experiment were caught within the round; both are recorded as bound corrections rather than quietly fixed.
subject: src/aionq/pond.py::storm -- long, optionally adaptive streams of quadratic parity heralds on a Gaussian state

measurement_1_the_field_predicts_every_p.statement: p(+1) = (1 + Gamma_ab)/2, read off one entry of the covariance matrix
measurement_1_the_field_predicts_every_p.checked_against: the exact amplitude calculation, over all 28 mode pairs at n = 4
measurement_1_the_field_predicts_every_p.consequence: the entire storm, outcomes and all, is samplable from O(n^2) numbers. The classical record the storm produces carries no more information than the covariance matrix already did, so there is no magic in what is collected either.

adaptive.rule: the next mode pair is chosen from the record of outcomes so far

measurement_2_two_hundred_heralds_never_.why_adaptivity_was_the_case_to_test: it is the one route by which a disturbance could compound rather than reset, and it was named in R1K as the last untouched possibility.
measurement_2_two_hundred_heralds_never_.sampling_discipline: outcomes are drawn at the probability the field predicts rather than post-selected, so these are trajectories the experiment would actually produce. A post-selected trajectory would be a different and much weaker claim.

measurement_3_the_storm_is_a_sink_toward.mechanism: under Jordan-Wigner i c_a c_b is a Pauli string, so a storm of quadratic parity heralds is repeated Pauli measurement, which drives any state into the stabiliser set
measurement_3_the_storm_is_a_sink_toward.signature: the entanglement entropy stops being a generic real number
measurement_3_the_storm_is_a_sink_toward.reading: integers, and powers of two. Gaussianity never moves; the entropy does. The storm does not add anything to the state -- it removes the part of the state that was not stabiliser.

near_miss_1_the_control_could_not_fire.what_happened: the positive control was a quartic herald applied to a post-storm n = 4 state. It fired at probability 1.000: the state was already an eigenvector of the observable, so the projection did nothing and the Wick defect read 1.1e-16.
near_miss_1_the_control_could_not_fire.what_would_have_been_reported: 'even a quartic herald cannot disturb a post-storm state' -- a striking claim, and false.
near_miss_1_the_control_could_not_fire.the_tell: the probability, not the defect. A herald at p = 0 or 1 has not measured anything.
near_miss_1_the_control_could_not_fire.generalisation: a control that cannot fire is not a control. This is the twelfth occurrence in this repository of the pattern 'a guard whose witness cannot reach the case it asserts', and the first in which the unreachable case was a POSITIVE control rather than a guard.
near_miss_1_the_control_could_not_fire.bound_correction: self_audit CORRECTIONS entry QSigma-R1l, first of two

near_miss_2_the_replacement_reading_was_.what_happened: having caught the vacuous control, the next reading was that the storm destroys a state's capacity to receive magic. That was drawn from one seed at n = 4.

what_the_scan_says.n=4_vacuous_quartic_heralds: 1 of 36 across 12 seeds -- so the eigenvector coincidence was a single-seed accident, not a property of post-storm states
what_the_scan_says.n=4_receptivity: 3 of 12 seeds have a live quartic herald reaching wick_defect above 0.5
what_the_scan_says.n=6_receptivity: 6 of 6 seeds, every one at exactly 1.0

near_miss_2_the_replacement_reading_was_.the_corrected_statement: a post-storm state CAN still receive magic. The size dependence is about how OFTEN, not about whether: at n = 6 every seed's post-storm state is taken to the largest Wick defect seen anywhere in this repository by some quartic herald.
near_miss_2_the_replacement_reading_was_.the_methodological_point: two successive readings of the same experiment were both artifacts of a single small case. Catching a bad control is not the same as having a good one, and the corrected reading needed its own control exactly as much as the original did.
near_miss_2_the_replacement_reading_was_.bound_correction: self_audit CORRECTIONS entry QSigma-R1l, second of two

what_the_arc_now_establishes.R1J: braids, theta-deformations and Floquet drives all stay inside the free-fermion class; only an interaction leaves
what_the_arc_now_establishes.R1K: heralding a quadratic parity stays inside; heralding a quartic parity leaves. The degree of the observable is the variable, not the act of measuring or post-selecting
what_the_arc_now_establishes.R1L: compounding and adaptivity change nothing: 200 heralds, chosen from the outcome record, stay inside. The storm is a sink toward stabiliser states, and the outcome record itself is samplable from the covariance matrix
what_the_arc_now_establishes.together: free fermions plus quadratic parity measurement with post-selection, adaptive, of any length, is closed. Every route tried that looked as though it should escape -- topology, motion, deformation, measurement, post-selection, adaptivity, accumulation -- does not. The only thing that escapes is an observable or a Hamiltonian term of degree four.

what_is_not_claimed: that free fermions plus measurement cannot be universal. The literature route is exactly the one measured to work here -- non-Gaussian observables or resource states -- and nothing refutes it. What is closed is the weaker hope that quadratic heralding, compounded or adapted, supplies the departure by itself.

that the stabiliser identification is proved. It is an identification from a signature: integer entropies and power-of-two supports, on a state that started at 1.7168. No stabiliser-group extraction was performed and the claim is at the level of evidence, not proof.
anything about mixed states or noise. Every trajectory here is pure, because parity projections preserve purity on a pure input. A noisy storm is a different object and was not measured.
anything about richer fusion rules, which R1J named as untested and which remain so.

typed_remainders.statement: the storm was run at n = 4, 5 and 6, and the receptivity scan at n = 4 (12 seeds) and n = 6 (6 seeds). wick_defect costs O(C(2n,4) * 4^n) and the test file now takes 154 seconds, which is close to the limit of what belongs in a suite. Whether the receptivity fraction continues to rise with n is not measured beyond 6.

the sink is identified as the stabiliser set from the entropy signature, and the mechanism (i c_a c_b is a Pauli string under Jordan-Wigner) is structural. But the storm samples mode pairs uniformly, so it is repeated measurement of a RANDOM Pauli from a restricted family, and which stabiliser states are reachable was not characterised.

the adaptive rule is one deterministic function of the outcome record, chosen for being cheap and non-trivial rather than for being the best adversary. A different adaptive strategy is not ruled out by this measurement, and the structural argument -- Gaussian measurements are closed under any choice of which one to make next -- is stronger than the measurement and is what actually carries the claim.
